# What each entry may import

<!-- Generated by `bun scripts/rules.ts --doc` from the rules in `scripts/rules.ts`. Edit a rule's `says` there, not this page. -->

Each entry of the package keeps to a small set of imports, so installing one does not drag in the others.
`bun run verify` fails on an import that breaks a rule. A type-only import is free.

| Rule | What it says |
| --- | --- |
| `kernel-pure` | `watchpot/core` is pure: it imports no React, UI, motion, shader, confetti or audio package, and nothing from `/react` or `/kit`. |
| `core-no-react` | `watchpot/core` and `watchpot/sim` never import React, React DOM, motion or the shader package. |
| `kit-props-only` | `watchpot/kit` takes props only: it imports no store and no entry other than `/core` (narrowly). |
| `kit-lookless` | `watchpot/kit` ships no look: it imports no stylesheet, motion or shader package. |
| `kit-core-narrow` | From `/core`, `watchpot/kit` reads only formatting, `decimal` helpers and types. |
| `ui-headless` | `watchpot/ui` imports React, React DOM, its own folder, the page-layout hook and `/core`, and no stylesheet, kit, motion or store. |
| `ui-core-narrow` | From `/core`, `watchpot/ui` reads only formatting, `decimal` helpers and types. |
| `shader-alone` | `watchpot/shader` imports nothing but React and its own folder. |
| `sound-alone` | `watchpot/sound` imports nothing but its own folder and `zzfx` (`watchpot/sound/pack` is exempt). |
| `sound-pack-build-time` | `watchpot/sound/pack` runs in Bun at build time: nothing the sound entry reaches imports it. |
| `three-narrow` | `watchpot/three` imports from the engine only `/core` and the prefs hook, and no stylesheet. |
| `devtools-narrow` | `watchpot/devtools` imports the store hooks, `/core`, the sound engine and `/ui`, and no kit, sim, test kit, 3D stage or shader. |
| `devtools-alone` | No other entry imports `watchpot/devtools`, which carries stylesheets: only a game does. |
| `desk-narrow` | The sim desk (`src/desk/`) imports `/sim`, `/core`, the command's types and the tools' tokens, and no other engine entry. |
| `desk-alone` | No engine entry imports the sim desk (`src/desk/`); the `sim` command loads it with a dynamic import. |
| `three-alone` | No other entry imports `watchpot/three`, so no other entry pulls `three` in. |
| `cli-alone` | The `watchpot` command (`src/cli/`) imports Node's built-ins and its own folder (and, under Bun only, the desk server): no engine entry, no React. |

The engine also reads no wall clock (the caller passes `now`) and ships no stylesheet or class name outside the dev panel.
